title: Gary Nolan's CIA file on UFO experiencers and Havana syndrome
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Gary Nolan's CIA file on UFO experiencers and Havana syndrome, about 2010s at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And I remember talking to Gary Nolan and he mentioned that he was kind of given a file by the CIA and he was tasked with looking into this.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a scientist named Garry Nolan told him the CIA, the US spy agency, once handed him a file and asked him to look into it. As the story goes, the file was about people who report UFO encounters and about Havana syndrome, a set of unexplained symptoms reported by US officials, sometime in the 2010s. If true, it would mean the agency quietly asked an outside scientist for help with these cases.
